title: Waterfalls & Wine Tour-Multnomah Falls,Vineyards,Hood River Combo
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: This is an amazing way to see the most spectacular Oregon wonders like Multnomah Falls, Vista Point driving thru the breathtaking and rugged beauty of the Columbia Gorge. We will see various waterfalls like Multnomah Falls, Latourell Falls , a lunch stop in the quaint historic downtown Hood River, a wine tasting stop at one of the amazing Vineyards in the Columbia Gorge AVA. This is ideal if you want to do some scenic, nature stops with light trail walking and also enjoy a vineyard stop, its absolutely the most amazing way to spend 8 hours.
